summary: E2E frontend + integration testing of DigiKawsay MVP. Supabase host is now resolvable (fitjpyqrecgvlrlpwipn.supabase.co) — the previous NXDOMAIN blocker is gone. All 9 requested flows PASS: login, dashboard stats, /reportes with all 5 report types (all generate successfully), /cierre with 12-month grid + Validar validation panel, /tesoreria, /facturas, /cartera. Minor UX gap: sidebar navigation is missing a link to /cierre (Cierre Contable) — only reachable via direct URL. Static code review flagged some HIGH-priority backend concerns (already reported in iteration_1) that remain unfixed but do not block current test scope.

minor.issue: Read-modify-write on document_sequences + non-transactional invoice+lines insert. Race condition + orphaned sequence numbers on failure. Should be wrapped in a Postgres RPC (unchanged since iteration_1).
Does not verify at least one row was updated; returns success even if invoice was already APPROVED (unchanged since iteration_1).
Not verified via unit tests, but flow works end-to-end. `accounting_periods` table auto-creation on validate/close works — cierre grid renders all 12 months with default OPEN status.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Cierre Contable' link is MISSING from sidebar navItems. The /cierre page exists and works, but users cannot reach it from the UI — only via direct URL. Should add {href:'/cierre', label:'Cierre Contable', icon:'🔒'}.

Uses inline `style={{}}` with hsl(var(--...)) CSS variables everywhere instead of Tailwind classes. Works, but inconsistent with the Tailwind-based pages. Error banner shows raw Supabase strings such as 'Failed to fetch' — no i18n.
Uses browser alert()/confirm() for error surfaces and confirmation dialogs. Poor UX and untestable via a11y. Should use shadcn Dialog/Toast.

iteration_1 flagged duplicate data-testid='new-invoice-btn' on two Nueva Factura buttons — visually confirmed today: 'Facturas de Venta' and 'Facturas de Compra' each render a 'Nueva Factura' button. Selector still ambiguous.

issues: Year selector defaults to 2026. All months render as OPEN which is expected when no periods have been created yet. Layout is clean; 4-column grid renders well on desktop.
Renders correctly with INGRESOS OPERACIONALES (413505 - Venta de Mercancías $5.000.000), UTILIDAD BRUTA $5.000.000, GASTOS $0, UTILIDAD NETA $5.000.000. Numbers reconcile with dashboard.
Aging analysis renders correctly. Table shows FV-00002 Comercializadora XYZ Ltda $5.950.000 in 'Corriente' bucket — data flows correctly from invoices.
